chapter: Family, Margaret's story and Eutris's memories
title: How Eutris bought the trombone
summary: She paid for the horn at about 13 after brother Garnett, who played trombone, refused him the money.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Picking up the horn: first instrument and the trombone

blocks.x: The trombone you bought Jay C. - how old was he when you bought it, do you remember?
That was about 19 - what would that be?
So it would be around 1919. What was the occasion when you bought the trombone? What made you buy it?

Well, he can tell you how they happened to be playing together, you know. There were, I think, 5 boys. This was in a town out from Atlanta, in Decatur, Georgia. Wasn't it Mr. Scott, Jay, that started this? This man was one of the professors from Agnes Scott College and he had all these boys together. I guess they were trying to get a little band together and of course there was 5 boys other than Jay. After he got them together my oldest brother didn't want him to play a trombone, I'm sure of that.
Well, I think he thought he was too young.
Was that the one - had anyone else played before?
Yes, he's the one that had played. He didn't give him the money. He wouldn't give him the money to pay on his horn. I gave him the money to pay for this horn.
how long had he been playing and how did he get started?
I don't know how he got started. Oh, that was just something on the side.
He picked it up at school as a sideline.
Yes, he must have picked it up at school.
He was teaching school then and so he just worried like a typical person, he didn't want Jay C. to start playing.
